# routeros_ip_proxy (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `always_from_cache` (Boolean) Ignore the client refresh requests if the cached content is considered fresh.
- `anonymous` (Boolean) Do not pass the client's IP address on in the `X-Forwarded-For` header.
- `cache_administrator` (String) Administrator e-mail address displayed on the proxy error pages.
- `cache_hit_dscp` (Number) DSCP value the proxy sets on the packets it serves from the cache.
- `cache_on_disk` (Boolean) Store the cache on the router's disk instead of in RAM.
- `cache_path` (String) Directory used for the on-disk cache.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables the web proxy service.
- `max_cache_object_size` (Number) Maximum size of a single cached object, in KiB.
- `max_cache_size` (String) Total cache capacity: `none`, `unlimited` or a size in KiB.
- `max_client_connections` (Number) Maximum number of simultaneous client connections that are accepted.
- `max_fresh_time` (String) Maximum period an object is kept in the cache.
- `max_server_connections` (Number) Maximum number of simultaneous connections towards the servers.
- `parent_proxy` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address of the upstream (parent) proxy server.
- `parent_proxy_port` (Number) TCP port the upstream (parent) proxy listens on.
- `port` (Number) TCP port the proxy service listens on.
- `serialize_connections` (Boolean) Process the persistent client connections one after another instead of in parallel.
- `src_address` (String) Local address used as the source of the connections the proxy makes towards the servers.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
